deployment.name: any build that uses a Dockerfile; an image built by a platform with no Dockerfile in the repository is invisible here

preconditions.statement: A person who can query the project's own container registry is available; the agent never reaches a registry and never resolves a tag itself.
preconditions.evidencePrompt: Which role owns the image update routine? A role, never a name.

fixtures.plants: A Dockerfile whose base carries a moving tag; the finder must locate it by file and line and mark it FLOATING.

A multi-stage file whose second FROM names the stage above it; that line must not be read as a base image. The phantom-image trap, and the failure mode the previous recipe in this directory shipped and corrected.
The same file; the gate line says "each pinned by digest", so it must be withheld while any base is not.
A base pinned by digest; it must not be reported as a finding, and with nothing else floating the evidence line is offered.
A tagged base and no registry; the output must contain no sha256 value at all, because resolving one needs a network this recipe does not touch.
A base supplied by a build argument; it must be marked UNRESOLVED and must not count as pinned. An unknown is not a pass.
A project with no Dockerfile; the recipe must say so, hand back no evidence line, and name the case it cannot see.

refusalTest.refusedLooksLike: any base that is not pinned by a digest withholds the gate line for the whole repository, and a base supplied by a build argument is marked UNRESOLVED rather than assumed pinned; no sha256 value appears in the output that was not already in the file

exposure.covered: the base images declared by FROM in this repository's Dockerfiles, and whether each is a digest or a movable tag
exposure.notCovered: an image built with no Dockerfile in the repository; a base supplied by a build argument the builder chooses; what a digest actually contains; whether anyone refreshes it; and every registry-specific command, which this recipe has not run and therefore does not print
exposure.behind: the journal entry recording the update routine, which gate 60 asks for in the same breath — a pin nobody refreshes is an unpatched image with a date on it, and no file can show a habit

evidenceLine.template: bases-pinned — evidence: the FROM lines at <locations>, each pinned by digest, read <date>

steps: Nothing in the repository to revert: the recipe wrote no file. A digest a person wrote in is replaced by the tag it came from, in the same Dockerfile.

postconditions.buildNotWorse: run the project's own check before and after; restore every written file and refuse if it was clean and is not
postconditions.refusalLeavesNoTrace: a recipe that cannot finish writes nothing at all
